title: gaia-dr4
description:
This repository prepares to check earlier claims once Gaia's fourth data release (DR4) is out, on three questions: planets validated by machine learning alone, blends among the 665 TESS candidates of eumemic/exoplanets (as of 14 Oct 2026), and old eclipses of long-period DR4 binaries on the Harvard plates.

Status: preparing. No results yet.

The Gaia ESA Archive is scheduled to go down on Wednesday 25 November 2026, 12:00 CET, until DR4 is released on Wednesday 2 December 2026, about 12:00 CET.

Directed by Ahraz Arifuddin

Researched and verified by different model families across Gemini, Claude, Grok, OpenAI, and Muse
